name: agentfence
description: Agentfence — identity, audit, and autonomy-boundary control plane for autonomous AI agents

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agentfence/core build && pnpm --filter @agentfence/services build && pnpm --filter @agentfence/adapters build && pnpm --filter @agentfence/api-server build
scripts.codegen:core: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src .codegen/.venv/bin/python -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --all --layers core --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:identity: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src .codegen/.venv/bin/python -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain identity --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
